summary: Iteration 3 — Transaksi (Kasir) tab improvements. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass; seed data preserved (products=2268 [1 legacy leftover from prior iteration], settings.shopName='TOKO BAGUS'). Frontend Transaksi tab verified end-to-end via mobile viewport 390x844:  (1) scan-mode-input auto-focused on tab open (document.activeElement match, showSoftInputOnFocus disabled, autoFocus works). (2) Simulated HW scanner via fill+Enter (onSubmitEditing) hits /api/products/barcode/{code} and adds line; scanning the SAME barcode 6× correctly aggregates into 1 line with quantity increment. (3) After scanning 9 distinct items (overflow) the newest cart-line-* row is scrolled into viewport (bottom<=window.innerHeight) and briefly highlighted (backgroundColor: brandTertiary, cleared after ~1.6s). (4) Compact rows show qty stepper (cart-dec-*/cart-inc-* verified inc 1→3 and dec 3→2 update subtotal Rp 6.000→18.000→12.000), name, price/unit with pencil (edit-price-*), subtotal, and X remove (cart-remove-* verified line disappears). (5) Edit Harga bottom-sheet opens with edit-price-input + price-temporary + price-permanent + price-cancel; temporary edit changes ONLY the cart line (verified line shows Rp 99.999 but /api/products still returns original sell_price=14.500 for that product). (6) Permanent edit persists via PUT /api/products/{id} (verified 3.000→4.500 persisted; cart line also updates). (7) For a MANUAL cart line the edit-price sheet correctly hides price-permanent (only temp+cancel shown). (8) Tambah Item screen has all 5 testIDs: manual-name / manual-buy / manual-price / manual-barcode / manual-qty + manual-temporary (adds to cart, NOT to products — verified 0 rows for the manual-only name) and manual-permanent (POST /api/products, then addProduct into cart — verified new row appears in /api/products and cart in one action, cleanup successful). (9) Bayar → /checkout?step=pay renders numpad (numpad-0..9/000/back) + checkout-confirm-button; Uang Pas quick action + confirm creates transaction (tx count 90→91, 'Transaksi Berhasil' receipt shown with correct TOKO BAGUS header). rca_of_issue: BottomSheetTextInput dev overlay RCA: @gorhom/bottom-sheet's BottomSheetTextInput.js calls `TextInputState.currentlyFocusedInput()` in handleOnBlur (line 37) to compare focused input; on react-native-web the exported API is `currentlyFocusedField` (or the compat path differs by version), so the call throws. It is caught by React's error boundary and surfaces as LogBox red overlay in dev only. Fix: swap to a plain react-native TextInput inside the BottomSheetView (the price sheet is short enough that KeyboardAvoidingView + BottomSheetModal's own keyboardBehavior='interactive' will handle iOS keyboard), OR bump @gorhom/bottom-sheet to a version with the RNW patch, OR shim `TextInputState.currentlyFocusedInput` on web.
